cohort: 73 neonates with IUGR (birth weight below 70% of expected) admitted to the Neonatal Ward at Hvidovre Hospital during 2007-2009 and their mothers
finding: Maternal smoking and gestational hypertension were identified as important risk factors for IUGR, with the majority of infants experiencing catch-up growth by 12 months and a low rate of neurologically poor outcomes.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was performed in 78% of the cases.
